summary.text: Jedediah Hinkle is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 67 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he previously served in the Montana State Senate from 2015 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Hinkle earned a bachelor's degree from Montana State University in 2002, and his career experience includes owning a business.
He represented State Senate District 32 from 2015 to 2019, and Democrat Pat Flowers defeated him in the 2018 general election.
Hinkle won the District 67 House seat in 2020 and was re-elected in 2022 and 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Fish, Wildlife and Parks Committee and is assigned to the Natural Resources, Rules and Judiciary committees.
Earlier, he chaired the House Legislative Administration Committee in 2021-2022 and was vice chair of Fish, Wildlife and Parks in 2023-2024.
